subject: No time information in cpout file

messages.author: Dulal Mondal
messages.body:
Dear Users,
I am running a CpHMD simulation. In the cpout file, there is no time
information. How can I solve this problem?
I set ntwx=500 and ntcnstph=500 in the input file.
Thanking You
